## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up the sauce can with round ridged lid and set it beside the medium kitchenpot

Task description: Pick up the dark sauce jar with a red round ridged cap at the rear right of the table and place it on the tabletop to the right of the medium white kitchen pot in the center.

Success criteria: Place the sauce can near the pot on its right, approximately aligned front to back, upright with its red lid up and bottom stable on the table. Release it with both grippers open.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the middle of the can's labeled cylindrical section, avoiding the narrowing shoulder and lid rim. Open slightly wider than that section and confirm the fingers straddle it before closing, ensuring effective pad contact to reduce slippage.
- When approaching the pot's right side, leave clearance between the jar and gripper fingers and the pot wall and handle, avoiding contact during placement or withdrawal.
- Keep the red cap facing up and lower slowly during placement. Release only after the can base is supported by the table, avoiding a tip-over from releasing it while suspended.
